name: greeting
why: Should be social, not a product tour.

name: thanks
why: Acknowledgement should not reopen the task.

name: yes_no_capability
why: A direct capability question should be answered plainly.

name: definition
why: Simple definition should not become a tutorial.

name: one_line_math
why: Arithmetic should remain one line.

name: off_domain
why: Out-of-domain asks should decline in one line.
turns: Write me a poem about rain

name: one_fact
why: A bounded fact request should return the fact, not a stock report.

name: market_status
why: Short status check must be concise.
turns: Is the Indian market open right now?

name: latest_price
why: Price-only request should not trigger full analysis.

name: latest_price_brief
why: Explicit brevity should be honored without losing the live value.
turns: TCS price, just the number and source

name: one_metric
why: A single financial metric request is a concise read.

name: simple_comparison
why: A narrow comparison should use only decisive information.
turns: Which has higher PE, TCS or Infosys?

name: brief_news
why: Brief must constrain an otherwise broad news answer.
turns: Any Reliance news today? Keep it to 2 bullets.

name: clarify_minimum
why: Incomplete order should ask only the missing field.

name: no_visual_request
why: The user explicitly asks for text only.
turns: Explain SIP in two sentences, text only.

name: why_market_down
why: Causal market answer needs bounded explanation, not a full market report.

name: stock_snapshot
why: A requested analysis merits structured depth and data.

name: comparison_analysis
why: An explicit comparison needs a data-backed table but no decorative visuals.
turns: Compare TCS and Infosys for a long-term investor

name: screen
why: A screen should render a purposeful results card/list.
turns: Show me large-cap Indian stocks with ROE above 20%

name: technical_pattern
why: Tests whether chart-pattern overlays are kept proportional to the ask.
turns: Show technical chart patterns for Tata Motors

name: price_alert
why: An alert should create one actionable card with minimal supporting copy.

name: scheduled_invest
why: Scheduled purchase needs a draft/card, not an essay.

name: backtest
why: Backtest deserves results visual(s), but prose should interpret rather than duplicate them.
turns: Backtest buying TCS when RSI goes below 30 over 3 years

name: option_chain
why: Chain request warrants a focused data card and concise interpretation.

name: strategy_explainer
why: Trade-off explanation needs depth but should avoid duplicate charts/cards.
turns: What is a bull call spread?
